newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Willamette rated outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Willamette rated outperform.

text.p: -- Lehman started coverage of Willamette Industries Inc with an outperform rating on Monday.

-- Analyst James Flicker said in a research report that the shares are inexpensive relative to other paper and forest products companies tracked by Lehman. The stock has a $75 price target assuming modest price appreciation in Willamett's key paper grades, he wrote.
-- Willamette is a major producer of white paper and containerboard. Earlier this year it bought a major timerland company, which should boost its wood products operations, he said.
